label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), following a recent unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached-state input is S2 (in_state==2, 100% of mass), almost always after choosing a2 (common a2->S2 transition, 99% of mass); it never fires at D1/GO, on S1, or on a rare a1->S2 transition. Within a2->S2c steps (rate ~34%), it is gated/modulated by recent non-reward: requiring prev_reward==0 gives P 0.63 / R 0.66 / mass 0.86 and catches nearly all top-quartile activations; also allowing a non-reward two trials back (recorded) gives dev P 0.58 / R 0.85 / F1 0.69 / mass 0.94. Strongest activations come in runs of repeated unrewarded a2->S2c trials (often early in a block or episode), where activation grows across consecutive trials. It is weaker and rarer late in the episode (almost never after trial 90) and in high-value / long-rewarded streaks. Restricting to ep_trial<80 raises precision to 0.76. All variables are observed at D2, so no future variables are used. Precision stays incomplete because the episode-time and history dependence is graded.
